title: Introduction to AI for Cyber Security
officialTitle: Unit-1 (Teaching Hours: 6) Introduction to AI for Cyber security
summary: Covers applying AI in cybersecurity, the evolution from expert systems to data mining and AI, forms of automated learning, algorithm training & optimization, Jupyter Notebook fundamentals, and AI in security contexts.
memoryCodeMeaning: Evolution of AI, Learning Methods (S-U-R), Training & Optimization (D-T-E-O), Jupyter Notebooks, Cybersecurity Applications

topics.title: Applying AI in Cyber Security & Foundations
Evolution: Expert Systems to Data Mining and AI
Different Forms of Automated Learning (Supervised, Unsupervised, RL)

title: AI for Cyber Security Arsenal
officialTitle: Unit-2 (Teaching Hours: 6) AI for Cyber Security Arsenal
summary: Core algorithms for security analytics: classification, regression, dimensionality reduction (PCA), clustering (K-Means, DBSCAN), video anomaly detection, NLP for social media analysis, and large-scale image processing.
memoryCodeMeaning: Classification, Regression, Dimensionality Reduction, Clustering, Video Anomaly Detection, NLP for Social Media, Image Processing

topics.title: Video Anomaly Detection, Social NLP & Image Processing

title: Detecting Cyber Security Threats with AI
officialTitle: Unit-3 (Teaching Hours: 6) Detecting Cyber Security Threats with AI
summary: Threat detection models: Perceptron for spam, Support Vector Machines for image spam, Logistic Regression and Decision Trees for phishing, Naive Bayes for spam, and NLP threat detection pipelines.
memoryCodeMeaning: Perceptron (Spam), SVM (Image Spam), Logistic Regression (Phishing), Decision Tree (Phishing), Naive Bayes (Spam), NLP (Text Threat)

topics.title: Image Spam Detection with Support Vector Machines (SVM)
Phishing Detection with Logistic Regression & Decision Trees
Spam Detection with Naive Bayes & NLP Pipelines

title: Protecting Sensitive Information and Assets
officialTitle: Unit-4 (Teaching Hours: 6) Protecting Sensitive Information and Assets
summary: Identity defense: authentication abuse prevention (brute force, credential stuffing), account reputation scoring, user authentication with keystroke recognition, and biometric authentication with facial recognition.
memoryCodeMeaning: Authentication Abuse Prevention, Account Reputation Scoring, Keystroke Recognition, Facial Recognition

topics.title: Authentication Abuse Prevention (Brute Force, Stuffing, Spraying)

title: Fraud Prevention with AI Solutions
officialTitle: Unit-5 (Teaching Hours: 6) Fraud Prevention with AI Solutions
summary: Financial fraud prevention: leveraging machine learning algorithms, ensemble learning with bagging and boosting (Random Forest, AdaBoost, Gradient Boosting), Jupyter data analysis, and statistical evaluation metrics.
memoryCodeMeaning: Machine Learning for Fraud, Bagging and Boosting, Jupyter Data Analysis, Statistical Evaluation Metrics

topics.title: ML for Fraud Detection & The Class Imbalance Problem
Ensemble Effectiveness: Bagging vs Boosting Techniques
Fraud Data Analysis & Feature Engineering with Jupyter
